title: Three Cats on a Bench
description: Three cats sit side by side on a turquoise upholstered bench with wooden legs. A lavender cat on the left, a fluffy orange cat in the center raising one paw, and a sleek black cat on the right.
prompt: Three cats sitting on a turquoise bench with wooden legs: a lavender-grey cat on the left, a fluffy orange Persian cat in the center raising its paw, and a sleek midnight blue cat on the right. They are positioned in front of a decorative folding screen covered in pink roses and green leaves. Blue and clear bubbles float throughout the scene. The background shows a patterned wall on the left and a pink patterned curtain on the right. Artistic, detailed, painterly style with soft lighting.
